name: skyvision
description: Repository commands. Each Worker in package/ keeps its own dependencies and lockfile, which Workers Builds deploys from.

scripts.postinstall: npm ci --prefix package/dashboard --no-audit --no-fund && npm ci --prefix package/worker --no-audit --no-fund && npm ci --prefix package/docs --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: [ -f package/dashboard/.dev.vars ] || printf 'DEV_VIEWER_EMAIL=%s\n' "$(git config user.email)" > package/dashboard/.dev.vars; npm ci --prefix package/dashboard --no-audit --no-fund && npm start --prefix package/dashboard
scripts.audit: npm audit --prefix package/dashboard; npm audit --prefix package/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix package/dashboard && npm run typecheck --prefix package/worker
scripts.lint: biome format . && npm run check:architecture --prefix package/dashboard && npm run check:architecture --prefix package/worker && make lint
scripts.test: npm test --prefix package/dashboard && npm run test:ui --prefix package/dashboard && npm run test:react --prefix package/dashboard && npm test --prefix package/worker
